name: get_data_availability
title: Get FIRMS data availability
description:
The first and last UTC day for which each FIRMS detection source has data, so you can tell whether data for a date can exist before querying it, and explain gaps (for example, standard-processing sources are published months after observation).

With the user's FIRMS MAP_KEY connected it uses FIRMS's documented data_availability API (`method: firms_api`); without one it uses the public date service the FIRMS Fire Map uses (`method: fire_map_date_service`). Pass a FIRMS source ID or ALL. The result lists FIRMS documentation entries about data dates and latency.

Works with or without a MAP_KEY.
